level: Grade 10 - Entrance Examination (辽宁省中考真题)

children.notes: Notice 常用作应用文“通知”的标题，置于正文上方居中。
children.statement: “Notice” 作为标题时，首字母必须大写。
children.explanation: 英语应用文通知的标题首字母需大写，通常居中书写。

children.notes: 称谓语，用于面向全体学生发布通知。
children.statement: “All the students,” 是试卷给出的称呼语，不计入考查词数。
children.explanation: 题目说明开头和结尾已给出，不计入总词数，故 word_count 计为 0。

children.text: To select the best speakers for our upcoming debate with Guangming Middle School, our club will hold a school competition.
children.cn: 为了给即将与光明中学举行的辩论赛选拔最优秀的选手，我们社团将举办一场校内选拔赛。
children.notes: To select: 动词不定式作目的状语; upcoming: 即将到来的; debate: 辩论赛; hold a competition: 举办比赛
children.statement: 句首动词不定式短语 “To select...” 在本句中作目的状语。
children.explanation: 动词不定式置于句首常用来表示行动的目的，意为“为了选拔优秀辩手”。
children.keywords: select the best speakers, upcoming debate, school competition

children.text: It will take place in the school hall at 3:00 pm next Friday.
children.cn: 比赛将于下周五下午3点在学校大厅举行。
children.notes: take place: 举行，发生; school hall: 学校大厅; at 3:00 pm next Friday: 下周五下午3点
children.statement: “take place” 意为“举行”，是不及物动词短语，通常不用被动语态。
children.explanation: take place 表示预先安排好的事情举行或发生，无被动语态。
children.keywords: take place, school hall, 3:00 pm next Friday

children.text: During the contest, each speaker needs to give a short speech and then answer questions from the judges.
children.cn: 在比赛期间，每位选手需要先作简短演讲，然后回答评委的提问。
children.notes: give a short speech: 作简短演讲; answer questions from...: 回答来自……的提问; judges: 评委
children.statement: “each speaker” 作主语时，谓语动词 need 使用第三人称单数形式 needs。
children.explanation: each 修饰单数可数名词作主语时，谓语动词用单数形式。
children.keywords: contest, each speaker, needs to, give a short speech, answer questions, judges

children.text: If you want to take part, please sign up in Room 201 or email us by 5:00 pm next Wednesday.
children.cn: 如果你想参加，请在下周三下午5点前到201室报名或给我们发送电子邮件。
children.notes: take part: 参加; sign up: 报名; by 5:00 pm: 在下午5点之前（by 表示不迟于某个时间点）
children.statement: “by 5:00 pm next Wednesday” 中的介词 “by” 意为“不迟于、在……之前”。
children.explanation: 在表达截止时间时，介词 by + 具体时间点是标准、地道的中考核心表达。
children.keywords: take part, sign up, Room 201, email us, by 5:00 pm next Wednesday

children.text: Do not miss this great chance to show your talent! We look forward to seeing you there.
children.cn: 不要错过这个展现你才华的绝佳机会！我们期待在比赛现场见到你。
children.notes: show one's talent: 展现才华; look forward to doing sth.: 期待做某事（to 为介词，后接 seeing）
children.statement: “look forward to seeing you” 中 seeing 使用了动名词形式。
children.explanation: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面必须跟动名词或名词短语。
children.keywords: Do not miss, great chance, show your talent, look forward to seeing you

children.notes: 发布通知的组织落款，位于正文右下角。
children.statement: “English Club” 是预先给出的落款，不计入考查词数。
children.explanation: 根据题目要求，预给出的开头和落款不计入总词数。

tree.cn: 辩论赛选拔通知 (高分进阶)

children.notes: Notice 常用作应用文“通知”的标题，置于正文上方居中。
children.statement: 高级范文的标题与基础范文保持完全一致。
children.explanation: 根据规范，预先给出的标题、称呼与落款在两篇范文中必须保持 100% 一致。

children.notes: 称谓语，用于面向全体学生发布通知。
children.statement: “All the students,” 属于题目预给内容，词数计为 0。
children.explanation: 开头已给出内容不计入总词数。

children.text: In order to select outstanding debaters for the upcoming contest against Guangming Middle School, our club has decided to host a school competition.
children.cn: 为了给即将与光明中学举行的辩论赛选拔优秀辩手，我们社团决定举办一场校内选拔赛。
children.notes: In order to: 为了（表目的）; select: 选拔; outstanding debaters: 出色的辩手; contest against: 与……对决的比赛; host: 主办，举办
children.statement: “In order to select” 引导目的状语，比 “To choose” 更加正式地道。
children.explanation: in order to 引导目的状语，书面表达更规范严谨，搭配 select 与 debaters 展现高级词汇运用能力。
children.keywords: In order to, select outstanding debaters, contest against, decided to host

children.text: It is scheduled to be held in the school lecture hall at 3:00 pm next Friday.
children.cn: 比赛定于下周五下午3点在学校报告厅举行。
children.notes: be scheduled to be held: 定于被举行（不定式的被动语态）; lecture hall: 报告厅
children.statement: “be scheduled to be held” 使用了动词不定式的被动形式。
children.explanation: 主语 It（指代比赛）与 hold 是被动关系，故采用 to be held。
children.keywords: scheduled to be held, school lecture hall, 3:00 pm next Friday

children.text: During the competition, every participant will first deliver a short speech and then answer questions raised by the judges.
children.cn: 在比赛期间，每位参赛选手将首先作简短发言，然后回答评委提出的问题。
children.notes: deliver a speech: 发表演讲; questions raised by...: 由……提出的问题（过去分词作后置定语）
children.statement: “raised by the judges” 是过去分词短语作后置定语，修饰前面的 questions。
children.explanation: 过去分词短语 raised by... 表被动和完成，作后置定语修饰名词 questions，是中考高分语法亮点。
children.keywords: competition, every participant, deliver a short speech, questions raised by the judges

children.text: Anyone who wishes to take part can register at our office or send an email to us by 5:00 pm next Wednesday.
children.cn: 凡是希望参赛的同学，均可在下周三下午5点前到社团办公室登记或给我们发送电子邮件。
children.notes: Anyone who wishes to...: 凡是希望……的人（定语从句）; register: 登记，报名; by 5:00 pm next Wednesday: 在下周三下午5点前
children.statement: “who wishes to take part” 是修饰代词 Anyone 的定语从句，从句谓语 wishes 用单数形式。
children.explanation: 先行词 Anyone 为不定代词，关系代词 who 在定语从句中作主语时，谓语动词需用单数形式 wishes。
children.keywords: Anyone who wishes to take part, register, office, send an email, by 5:00 pm next Wednesday

children.text: Do not miss this wonderful chance to display your talent and challenge yourself! We warmly welcome your participation.
children.cn: 切莫错过这个展现才华和挑战自我的良机！我们热忱欢迎大家的参与。
children.notes: display your talent: 展现才华; challenge yourself: 挑战自我; warmly welcome: 热烈欢迎; participation: 参与（名词）
children.statement: “participation” 是动词 participate 的名词形式，作 welcome 的宾语。
children.explanation: warmly welcome your participation（热忱欢迎大家的参与）是通知结尾非常得体地道的高级表达。
children.keywords: Do not miss, wonderful chance, display your talent, challenge yourself, warmly welcome your participation

children.notes: 发布通知的组织落款，位于正文右下角。
children.statement: 落款内容在两篇模型作文中保持 100% 一致。
children.explanation: 根据规范，高级模型同样保持预给落款的一致性，不计入考查词数。
